evals.expected_output: The skill validates the draft PR gates in order and flips with gh pr ready only when all pass.
evals.prompt: CI just went green on PR #42 in shikanime-labs/skills, take it out of draft for review.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-ready'
Description starts with 'Use when' and is <= 200 characters
license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body pins the PR head via headRefOid before any other gate
Body requires CI green via gh pr checks before the flip
Body requires the first review done with no unresolved blocking finding
Body flips the draft via gh pr ready
Body states the skill never merges

evals.expected_output: The skill reconciles the PR body with the current diff on every push or update before the flip.
evals.prompt: I pushed a new commit to my draft PR, update it and make it ready for human review.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-ready'
Description starts with 'Use when' and is <= 200 characters
license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body reconciles the body with the diff on every push or update
Body deletes claims absent from the current diff
Body restarts the gate train at step 1 after any push

evals.expected_output: The skill routes merging away; landing belongs to sks-land after human approval.
evals.prompt: Merge my ready PR now that the checks pass.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-ready'
Description starts with 'Use when' and is <= 200 characters
license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body delegates landing/merging to sks-land
Body never merges itself

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies as sks-pr-ready; writing a poem is out of scope.
